test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Ram rides at the rate of 36 km/h but stops for five minutes to take a drink at the end of every 10 km. Find the time that Ram will take to cover a distance of 84 km.
solution: **Formula used** Distance = Speed × time **Calculation** Time required by Ram to cover 84 km distance with a rate 36km/hr = 84/36 = 7/3 or 2(1/3) = 2 hr 20 min (140 minutes)
